name: PubLayNet
description: A large document-image dataset with bounding-box and polygon segmentation annotations for document layout analysis, generated by matching PDF and XML versions of PubMed Central articles.
citation: Zhong, X., Tang, J., and Yepes, A. J. (2019). PubLayNet: largest dataset ever for document layout analysis. https://arxiv.org/abs/1908.07836

license.notes: The annotations are licensed under CDLA-Permissive-1.0; source images are subject to the PubMed Central Open Access Subset Terms of Use.
